package.name: sensor_models
package.description:
Reusable xacro sensor macros for Gazebo simulation.
L1 LiDAR macro: l1_lidar — Gazebo Fortress (Ignition Gazebo 6, ROS 2 Humble) Uses gpu_lidar sensor type and ignition_frame_id. Interface: parent, prefix, *origin (block).
Add new macros here when porting to additional robot platforms.
